Indexed content of buschlaw.com does support 2875 US Highway 1 at Finnegans Lane with (732) 821-2300, so the mapper is probably right, but the record rests on index text rather than an opened page.
issues.fix: Confirm by phone before listing it as verified; keep the caveat.

issues.claim: Home-based and micro-business entries (Total Residential Appraisal at 110 Hollywood Street, Mangia Marketing, Cray Marketing, WebTheory Media, Power Up Consulting, Polyolefins, Sidi Income Tax, CAS AMIE)
issues.problem: These addresses are residential properties (public parcel records show 110 Hollywood Street as a single-family house), several with no website and one-person practices. They are legitimate business listings, but they are unlikely B2B consulting prospects and outreach to a home address is easy to get wrong.
issues.fix: Tier them separately or drop the smallest; at minimum flag 'home-based' in the record so nobody mails or door-knocks a residence.

issues.problem: My own searches found two North Brunswick businesses in categories the list already covers that are not in it: Roy S. Chereath CPA (1670 US Highway 130, 732-422-4214) and Perfect Cents LLC (1648 US-130; bookkeeping, QuickBooks cleanup, tax). Both are single-directory leads but in-scope.
issues.fix: Add both after a phone or site check, or record why they were left out.

issues.problem: Searches for dentist, roofing and HVAC in North Brunswick return many established local businesses that are absent from the list, while every listed category is an office/professional service. That is consistent with a group A defined as professional services, but the brief in this folder does not state the category set, so I cannot tell whether consumer trades and healthcare are out of scope by design.
issues.fix: Confirm groups A/B/C in the mapper brief. If group A was meant to include healthcare or trades this list is far short; if not, leave as is.

issues.claim: Directory-only entries carried forward (Prime Tax, Smart Cents, Sidi Income Tax, Shuja Financial, Mid County Agency, Paragon Staffing, Law Office of Gregory Jaeger, KNS Financial, First Trade Show, BetaBulls, CAS AMIE, Polyolefins, Home Access Realty, Dell Principle Brokerage, Trinity Realty)

issues.fix: Keep them in a separate 'needs phone confirmation' tier so sales does not treat them as confirmed, as the caveats section already advises.
